name: Variety Show
description: Variety Show is coming up!! Come watch your friends: Sing, Dance, Act and more!! Show is on Friday, March 20th, 2026 @ 4:00pm at The Stage at Los Alamitos.

name: Hicklebee's Book Fair
description: The Hicklebee's Book Fair is coming to Los Alamitos! Every spring, the PTA hosts a second book fair to promote summer reading. This year, they're partnering with the local children's bookstore, Hicklebee's, who will provide the books. The fair runs from Tuesday to Thursday, March 24th to 26th, from 8:30 AM to 3:00 PM in the Library. There is also a special Family Night on Tuesday, March 24th from 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM.

name: Multicultural Faire
description: The PTA is eager and excited to have different cultures from around the world at our Annual Multicultural Faire! We would love to see you there, hosting a Booth or do a Performance showcasing your culture. If you or someone you know, would like to perform for Los Alamitos MCF, please reach out to us. It's a great opportunity for our kids to get involved, learn, and even present what they've prepared.

name: K/3 Buddy Egg Hunt
description: Kindergarten students will participate in a Spring Egg Hunt with their 3rd grade buddies. Parents are asked to donate 16 plastic eggs filled with non-candy items like stickers, erasers, small toys, etc.

name: Hidden Villa Farm Field Trip
description: K-2 classes will go on a field trip to Hidden Villa Farm. Parents should pack a disposable lunch and water bottle for their child, and make sure they wear sensible walking shoes and their Dandy Day t-shirt.

description: The current slate for the 2026-2027 PTA Executive Board will be voted on at this meeting.

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. We are looking for volunteers who can come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday) from 12:45pm - 2:00pm during the school year. Training for new tutors is provided!! Helping these new & growing readers is super fun and rewarding!

name: Castillero Athletic Booster Club
description: Attention 5th grade parents! Looking to get involved at Castillero? Consider joining the Castillero Athletic Booster Club (CABC) Board! The time commitment is very manageable and it is a great way to get involved at Castillero!

name: Castillero Music Booster Club Fundraiser
description: Support Our CMBC Program – Sweeten Easter & Mother's Day! We've partnered with See's Candies once again to bring you delicious, high-quality chocolates just in time for Easter and Mother's Day. All sales from this storefront will support instruments, sheet music, and performance opportunities for our students—and we'd love your support!
